tool_schemas.name: claude_code
tool_schemas.description: Executes a Claude CLI–backed code agent for the given natural-language `prompt` and returns the execution record including the agent’s textual output plus any produced artifacts/logs; if `workFolder` is provided, it is used as the working directory and file/terminal/git operations are scoped to it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `prompt` is empty or `workFolder` is not an absolute path, and FORBIDDEN when the API key/workspace is not authorized or the agent attempts to access paths outside the allowed workspace/root or otherwise violates path-safety rules. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request or resource limits for the API key/workspace are exceeded, and CONFLICT when an operation is refused due to an invalid state transition for the execution (for example, attempting to run against an execution that is already completed or canceled).

prompt.description: The detailed natural language prompt for Claude to execute.

workFolder.description: Mandatory when using file operations or referencing any file. The working directory for the Claude CLI execution. Must be an absolute path.

tool_schemas.name: claude_code_list_runs
tool_schemas.description: Lists agent execution runs visible to the caller, newest-first. Supports filtering by workspace, status, and time range; refuses requests with invalid filters or insufficient scope.

workspaceId.description: Filter runs to a single workspace id.

apiKeyId.description: Filter runs created by a specific API key id.

fromRequestedAt.description: Include runs requested at or after this timestamp (RFC3339).

toRequestedAt.description: Include runs requested at or before this timestamp (RFC3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: claude_code_get_run
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single agent run by id, including its current status and final output fields when complete. Refuses if the run is not visible to the caller.

includeEvents.description: When true, includes recent run events inline (may be truncated).

includeArtifacts.description: When true, includes run artifacts metadata inline (not the raw bytes).

tool_schemas.name: claude_code_list_run_events
tool_schemas.description: Lists append-only event log entries for a run in sequence order. Supports incremental polling; refuses if the run is not visible to the caller.

afterSequence.description: Return only events with sequence strictly greater than this value.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: claude_code_cancel_run
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of a queued or running agent run. Transitions the run to cancelled when allowed by lifecycle rules; refuses if the run is already terminal or not cancellable.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the cancellation request (stored as an event).

tool_schemas.name: claude_code_redact_run_artifact
tool_schemas.description: Redacts or deletes a run artifact. Transitions artifact status from available->redacted or available/redacted->deleted and may remove stored content; refuses if the artifact is already deleted or the caller lacks permission.

action.description: Redaction action to apply to the artifact.

redactionNote.description: Optional note recorded for audit explaining what was redacted and why.

metadata.name: Claude Code Execution Server
